venue.name: Alberni Valley Museum
venue.description: The Alberni Valley Museum is the City of Port Alberni's community museum, with a collection linked to First Nations culture, local and industrial history and folk art. The whole collection is held in visible storage so it is on view at all times, with catalogue books beside it, and temporary exhibits change through the year. Admission is by donation and the main floor is wheelchair accessible. School programs for Kindergarten to Grade 12 run on Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays at two sites, the Museum and the Maritime Discovery Centre.
venue.address: 4255 Wallace Street, Port Alberni BC V9Y 3Y6

facility_notes.wheelchair_accessible: We are wheelchair accessible on the main floor. Museum Birthday Parties are held in the downstairs activity room at the Museum. Guests must be able to go up and down stairs. If an accessible party room is required, please let us know at the time of your booking.

restrictions: Groups (10 or more people) must book in advance.
venue.hours_notes: Tuesday, Wednesday & Saturday: 10 am to 4 pm. Thursday: 10 am to 8 pm. Friday: 10am to 3pm. Closed Sunday, Monday & Statutory Holidays.
venue.seasonal_notes: Dinosaurs of BC, a travelling exhibit produced by the Royal BC Museum, will be on display at the Alberni Valley Museum from September, 2026 to January, 2027.

programs.name: Dinosaur Discovery
programs.description: A school program for Kindergarten to Grade 3 in which students dig for dinosaur bones and find out what palaeontologists do. Programs run on Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays through the school year and must be booked at least two weeks ahead. There is a $50 fee for out of district schools and groups; the Beta Sigma Phi Legacy Fund covers the program fee for Port Alberni School classes. Programs are offered at two sites, the Museum and the Maritime Discovery Centre, and the site does not say which site this one runs at. Booking is through Sylvia Gropp, Education Curator, at 250-720-2501.
programs.what_children_do: Dig for dinosaur bones the way palaeontologists do, and find out what the bones tell you about prehistoric life.
programs.our_note: Booking needs two weeks' notice and only Wednesday, Thursday and Friday are offered, so a date can be tight in a busy term. If your class is not a Port Alberni School District class, expect the $50 fee. Ask which of the two sites this program runs at, because the museum and the Maritime Discovery Centre are not in the same building.
programs.practical_summary: The grade range, the booking notice, the days and the out of district fee are all published, and the main floor of the museum is wheelchair accessible. How long the program lasts, how many children can come, how many adults you need, washrooms and somewhere to eat lunch are not stated, so it is worth a call.
programs.evidence: Dinosaur Discovery: (Grades K-3) Your students discover the work of Palaeontologists as they dig for dinosaur bones

programs.name: Group visit
programs.description: Groups of ten or more people have to book a gallery time in advance by phone. Admission to the museum is by donation and no group rate or child rate is published. The collection is held in visible storage with catalogue books beside it, and temporary exhibits change through the year. There is also a virtual tour of the museum on the site.
programs.what_children_do: Walk the galleries at their own pace, looking at objects held in visible storage and at the catalogue books that explain them.
programs.our_note: Ten or more people have to call ahead for a gallery time, so ring 250-720-2863 before you fix a date. Admission is by donation with no amount published, so decide what your group will give and say so when you book. Only the main floor is described as wheelchair accessible.
programs.practical_summary: The address, the opening hours and a phone number for booking a group time are published, and the main floor is wheelchair accessible. Washrooms, somewhere to eat lunch, bus parking and any group or child admission rate are not stated anywhere, so it is worth a call.
programs.evidence: Groups (10 or more people) must book in advance.

programs.name: Self-guided historic walking tours
programs.description: Three self-guided walking tours of Port Alberni presented by the museum, each pamphlet carrying historic information and photographs about the built heritage of one part of the city. The Northport tour of the old town of Alberni is about 2.5 km and takes 30 to 40 minutes. The Southport harbour tour and the Southport residential tour are each under 1 km and take 10 to 20 minutes. The pamphlets can be read online, downloaded as PDFs, or picked up in paper at the museum at 4255 Wallace Street. No price is stated for the paper copies.
programs.what_children_do: Walk a set route through city streets, stopping at older buildings and matching them against the historic photographs in the pamphlet.
programs.our_note: These are streets rather than a site, with no booking and no staff, so you set the pace and turn back whenever you like. The two Southport routes are under a kilometre and are the manageable ones for short legs. There is no shelter, no washroom and nowhere to sit on the route, so plan around the weather.
programs.practical_summary: Three routes with their distances and walking times are published, and the pamphlets are online or on paper at the museum. There is no washroom, indoor space or rain shelter on the route, and no price is stated for the paper copies.
programs.evidence: Discover the rich history of Port Alberni with a self-guided historic walking tour.

programs.name: Birthday party at the museum
programs.description: Themed birthday parties held in the downstairs activity room at the museum, with five themes to choose from: Sweet Creations, Out of this World, Dinotastic Dig, Legends of the Sea and Museum Mystery. The museum provides the theme, games, activities, crafts and two party hosts. Ten party guests are included and extra guests are $10 each. Two adults have to stay for the whole party. The price of the party itself is not published on the site. Questions and changes go through the Echo Centre reception at 250-723-2181.
programs.what_children_do: Make the themed craft and play the games for the theme the group picked, run by two hosts in the activity room downstairs.
programs.our_note: The party room is downstairs and guests have to manage the stairs, so ask for the accessible room at the time of booking if anyone cannot. Ten children are included and every child after that is ten dollars, and two adults have to stay the whole time. The price of the party itself is not on the site, so ask when you call.
programs.practical_summary: The room, the five themes, what the museum provides and the extra guest fee are published, and two adults have to stay for the whole party. The party price, the age range and whether there is anywhere to eat are not stated, and the room is down a flight of stairs.
programs.extra_fees_note: Additional party guests beyond the ten included are $10 per guest. The general birthday party FAQ lists a Pizza Party Add-on at an additional $70 plus GST.
programs.cancellation_note: Up to 5 business days before your scheduled birthday party: Withdraw by 11:00 am on the Tuesday before your Saturday or Sunday Birthday to get a full refund without any admin fee. Within 5 days of the start of the birthday party: No refund will be granted for the birthday party.
programs.evidence: Up to 10 party guests are included with the option to add additional party guests at $10 per guest.
